card.name: Fluid being passed through a tube
card.fires_on: Verbs and small words right after a liquid that is being infused, injected, pumped or run, such as through, into, from, delivered. They point to the tube, catheter, vein or pipe the fluid moves along.

modes.label: Infusion route
modes.description: Word after an injected or infused solution naming the catheter or vein it goes through.

modes.description: Passive verb about a dose or fluid being given, before the route or target.
modes.example: Intravenous solutions should not be<< injected>> intramuscularly or subcutaneously

modes.label: Non-medical liquid flow
modes.description: Word after water, beer or gel being run, pumped or discarded.
